in_sanskrit.name: मोहना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Mohana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'मोहन' which means 'to attract, to charm, to allure, to fascinate'. The feminine form of this word is 'मोहना' which means 'delight' or 'charm'. In Hindu mythology, Mohana is the name of a demon who was enchanted by Lord Krishna's charm and beauty, and was eventually tamed by him.
